title: Fix 272 uninitialised root
no_spec_change_rationale: REQ-cli-040 already names journal add among the commands that hold the writer lock, with no exception for a project that has no .chough directory yet; only the code and its tests change.
acceptance_criteria: In a project with no .chough directory, chough journal add takes the writer lock .chough/local/checkpoint.lock before it writes, and twelve journal add commands run at once leave a feed that lists all twelve posts, with chough library index --check passing.
